prompt: What was state of the schools regarding integration in the hometown of Miller Williams when he began his master's degree in Zoology?
answer: When Miller Williams began his graduate work in zoology around 1951–52, the schools in his hometown of Hoxie, Arkansas, were still racially segregated. Hoxie’s public schools did not begin integrating until 1955—famously becoming the first Arkansas school district to do so after *Brown v. Board of Education*.
